blurb: The Rome Sports Hall of Fame is a non-profit organization dedicated to honoring and preserving the great sports achievements of athletes of Rome New York. We do this by recognizing those who have excelled, preserving and displaying a rich collection of historical artifacts, and providing visitors with a memorable experience.
